fokus.ui.kopf: The government's agenda: one focus at a time. Choosing a path closes the opposite one.
fokus.ui.keiner: No focus is running. Choose the next course.
fokus.ui.abbrechenHinweis: A quarter of the capital comes back; the time is lost.
fokus.ui.kosten: {pk} capital · {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
fokus.ui.dauer: The effect in the country is permanent.
fokus.ui.gesetz: Bill “{name}”: draft agreed, more yes votes
fokus.ui.forschung: Research across the knowledge tree somewhat faster
fokus.ui.legende: Line: prerequisite · crossed red line: opposite paths exclude each other
fokus.grund.ausgeschlossen: Excluded: the opposite path “{name}” was chosen.
fokus.satz.aktiv: The government is pursuing “{name}”, about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} to go.
fokus.satz.frei: No focus is running: {n, plural, one {# path is} other {# paths are}} open now.
fokus.satz.nichts: No focus is possible right now.
fokus.partner.plus: The party feels vindicated by the focus “{name}”.
fokus.partner.minus: The party sees its line abandoned in the focus “{name}”.
fokus.ast.wirtschaft.name: Economic Order
fokus.ast.wirtschaft.satz: Market or state, rate discipline or directed credit, exports or self-sufficiency.
fokus.ast.sicherheit.name: Security & Armed Forces
fokus.ast.sicherheit.satz: NATO or a Eurasian axis; drones, fleet, air defence and the border.
fokus.ast.gesellschaft.name: Society & Culture
fokus.ast.gesellschaft.satz: Secularism or religious order, liberties or the traditional family, recognition or unity.
fokus.ast.aussen.name: Foreign Policy & Alliances
fokus.ast.aussen.satz: Europe, the Turkic world or a path of its own between the blocs.
fokus.ast.staat.name: State, Justice & Constitution
fokus.ast.staat.satz: Presidential reach or a strong parliament with independent courts.
fokus.ast.regionen.name: Regions & Mega-Projects
fokus.ast.regionen.satz: Mega-projects or protection; earthquake safety, rail, water and ports.
fokus.ast.wissen.name: Science & Innovation
fokus.ast.wissen.satz: Artificial intelligence, chips, space, vaccines and the return of talent.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_auftakt.text: A comprehensive assessment by the Treasury sets the economic priorities for the coming decade.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_orthodoxie.unter: Central bank independence and rational rates
fokus.f.fok_wirt_orthodoxie.text: The Central Bank receives operational autonomy to curb inflation through orthodox rate adjustments.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_orthodoxie.zitat: Trust is the hardest currency in the world.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_privatisierung.unter: Downsizing state holdings and liberalizing markets
fokus.f.fok_wirt_privatisierung.text: Inefficient state-owned enterprises are privatized via transparent market listings.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_fdi_magnet.unter: Legal certainty and investor protection guarantees
fokus.f.fok_wirt_fdi_magnet.text: Comprehensive capital protections and tax incentives attract multinational direct investments.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_niedrigzins.titel: Targeted Credit Guidance and Low Rates
fokus.f.fok_wirt_niedrigzins.text: Public banks distribute subsidized low-interest credit directly to exporters and manufacturers.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_niedrigzins.zitat: Production and jobs must not be sacrificed to interest rates.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_verstaatlichung.text: Mining, telecommunications, and energy utilities are unified under the sovereign wealth fund.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_autarkie.unter: Import substitution for critical intermediate goods
fokus.f.fok_wirt_autarkie.text: Protective tariffs and local-content mandates mandate domestic production of capital goods.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_exportmotor.unter: Manufacturing powerhouse of the customs zone
fokus.f.fok_wirt_exportmotor.text: Upgrading automotive, white goods, and textile production for duty-free access to Western markets.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_mittelstand.unter: Supporting SME industrial clusters across inland cities
fokus.f.fok_wirt_mittelstand.text: Targeted tax relief and railway freight links for inland manufacturing hubs.
fokus.f.fok_wirt_logistikdrehscheibe.unt: Integrating mega-container ports from Black Sea to Mediterranean
fokus.f.fok_wirt_logistikdrehscheibe.tex: Connecting deep-water container ports across Anatolia establishes a continental transit bridge.
fokus.f.fok_sich_doktrin.unter: Adapting the armed forces to modern warfare
fokus.f.fok_sich_doktrin.text: The General Staff drafts a unified strategic plan centered on unmanned systems and networked deterrence.
fokus.f.fok_sich_doktrin.zitat: Who wants peace, prepare for war, with one's own hands and one's own mind.
fokus.f.fok_sich_drohnen.unter: Serial production of jet-powered unmanned combat aircraft
fokus.f.fok_sich_drohnen.text: Funding state-of-the-art stealth drone wings and autonomous swarm capabilities.
fokus.f.fok_sich_drohnen_export.unter: Leveraging domestic defense platforms for foreign policy leverage
fokus.f.fok_sich_drohnen_export.text: Providing defense financing to regional partners expands Turkish geopolitical influence.
fokus.f.fok_sich_kaan.text: Finalizing indigenous jet engine architecture guarantees immunity against foreign arms embargoes.
fokus.f.fok_sich_mavi_vatan.unter: Asserting exclusive economic rights across Aegean and Mediterranean
fokus.f.fok_sich_mavi_vatan.text: Continuous naval patrols escort exploration vessels and consolidate contested continental shelf claims.
fokus.f.fok_sich_flotte.text: Deploying drone carriers and silent AIP submarines guarantees undisputed control of the Turkish Straits.
fokus.f.fok_sich_nato.text: Leading joint exercises reaffirms Turkey's indispensable status in the transatlantic alliance.
fokus.f.fok_sich_eurasien.unter: Multipolar balance via eastern defense accords
fokus.f.fok_sich_eurasien.text: Acquiring advanced air defense systems and joint technology pacts outside the Western procurement sphere.
fokus.f.fok_sich_grenzkorridor.unter: Fortified buffer zones across southern borders
fokus.f.fok_sich_grenzkorridor.text: Sensor towers, physical barriers, and tactical forward operating bases seal southern approaches.
fokus.f.fok_sich_celik_kubbe.unter: Layered national air and missile shield architecture
fokus.f.fok_sich_celik_kubbe.text: Integrating low-to-high altitude missile batteries under a sovereign unified command network.
fokus.f.fok_sich_cyber.unter: Defending critical national grid and cyber retaliation assets
fokus.f.fok_sich_cyber.text: Establishing an elite cyber warfare branch guarding energy grids, telecoms, and administrative databanks.
fokus.f.fok_ges_pakt.unter: National dialogue on foundational civic values
fokus.f.fok_ges_pakt.text: A national convention brings together diverse civic groups to reduce political polarization.
fokus.f.fok_ges_pakt.zitat: Unity in the foundation, diversity in expression.
fokus.f.fok_ges_laizismus.unter: Strict demarcation between state administration and religious orders
fokus.f.fok_ges_laizismus.text: Public civil service and judiciary are firmly shielded from religious brotherhoods and patronage.
fokus.f.fok_ges_laizismus.zitat: The Republic of Türkiye cannot be a land of sheikhs, dervishes and disciples.
fokus.f.fok_ges_frauenrechte.unter: Zero tolerance for domestic violence and legal gender parity
fokus.f.fok_ges_frauenrechte.text: Reinstating international treaty protections and expanding state shelter infrastructure.
fokus.f.fok_ges_zivilgesellschaft.unter: Decriminalizing civic activism and peaceful assembly
fokus.f.fok_ges_zivilgesellschaft.text: Public square rally bans are repealed and independent non-governmental organizations empowered.
fokus.f.fok_ges_religioes.unter: Strengthening religious education and the Presidency of Religious Affairs
fokus.f.fok_ges_religioes.text: Expanding the curriculum's ethics and divinity modules across primary and secondary schools.
fokus.f.fok_ges_religioes.zitat: A people without spiritual roots is like a rootless tree in a storm.
fokus.f.fok_ges_familienwerte.unter: Marriage grants, birth incentives, and social family protections
fokus.f.fok_ges_familienwerte.text: Providing interest-free marriage allowances and graduated stipends starting from the third child.
fokus.f.fok_ges_moral_ordnung.unter: Regulating digital and broadcast media against cultural decadence
fokus.f.fok_ges_moral_ordnung.text: Imposing stricter regulatory penalties on digital platforms violating social decorum codes.
fokus.f.fok_ges_sprachenvielfalt.unter: Elective school courses and cultural institutes for mother tongues
fokus.f.fok_ges_sprachenvielfalt.text: State accreditation for Kurdish philology chairs and regional bilingual cultural centers.
fokus.f.fok_ges_versoehnung.text: Comprehensive amnesty for non-violent actors and broad inclusion into civil democratic politics.
fokus.f.fok_ges_versoehnung.zitat: Where free speech can make peace, let no weapon speak again.
fokus.f.fok_aus_doktrin.text: The Foreign Ministry formalizes an agile multi-vector diplomatic strategy balancing east and west.
fokus.f.fok_aus_doktrin.zitat: Peace at home, peace in the world.
fokus.f.fok_aus_zollunion.unter: Expanding the customs union into digital commerce, services and agriculture
fokus.f.fok_aus_zollunion.text: High-level negotiations with Brussels unlock duty-free European access for Turkish tech and agriculture.
fokus.f.fok_aus_visafreiheit.unter: Fulfilling final benchmarks for biometric visa-free Schengen access
fokus.f.fok_aus_visafreiheit.text: Revising anti-terror statutes and data privacy standards grants Turkish citizens barrier-free Schengen mobility.
fokus.f.fok_aus_tuerkische_welt.unter: Common market and capital alliance from Baku to Astana
fokus.f.fok_aus_tuerkische_welt.text: Activating the Turkic Investment Fund to finance trans-Caspian energy pipelines and trade corridors.
fokus.f.fok_aus_zangezur.unter: Linking up with the TRIPP route to Baku and Central Asia
fokus.f.fok_aus_zangezur.text: Türkiye links its rail and road networks to the route through southern Armenia, built under Armenian law with US development rights; Baku and Central Asia come closer without a detour via Russia or Iran.
fokus.f.fok_aus_vermittler.unter: Indispensable mediator in Black Sea and Levant regional disputes
fokus.f.fok_aus_vermittler.text: Strict enforcement of the Montreux Convention prevents maritime escalation and hosts summits in Istanbul.
fokus.f.fok_aus_brics.unter: Local-currency settlement frameworks and New Development Bank equity
fokus.f.fok_aus_brics.text: Formal BRICS membership curbs dollar vulnerability and links Turkish commerce to Global South liquidity.
fokus.f.fok_staat_verfassung.unter: Moving past the legacy of the 1982 coup-era charter
fokus.f.fok_staat_verfassung.text: An inter-party committee convenes to establish blueprints for a modern civilian constitution.
fokus.f.fok_staat_verfassung.zitat: Sovereignty belongs unconditionally to the nation.
fokus.f.fok_staat_verfassung.urheber: Inscription in the plenary hall of the Grand National Assembly
fokus.f.fok_staat_dekrete.unter: Accelerated governance via direct executive decrees bypassing legislative gridlock
fokus.f.fok_staat_dekrete.text: Presidential decrees receive fast-track legal standing for priority socio-economic measures.
fokus.f.fok_staat_hsk_kontrolle.unter: Executive appointment primacy on the Council of Judges and Prosecutors
fokus.f.fok_staat_hsk_kontrolle.text: Aligning senior magistrate appointments with constitutional stability and state rationale.
fokus.f.fok_staat_dauerherrschaft.unter: Removing term limitations to safeguard multi-decade state objectives
fokus.f.fok_staat_dauerherrschaft.text: Constitutional revision authorizing successive presidential candidacies upon popular mandate.
fokus.f.fok_staat_parlament.unter: Restoring the Prime Ministership and binding parliamentary oversight
fokus.f.fok_staat_parlament.text: Cabinet ministers answer directly to the assembly, instituting constructive votes of no-confidence.
fokus.f.fok_staat_justiz_autonomie.unter: Depoliticizing the magistrate council with peer elections
fokus.f.fok_staat_justiz_autonomie.text: Complete tenure protection and depoliticized judicial appointments guarantee unbiased jurisprudence.
fokus.f.fok_staat_transparenz.unter: Closing public tender loopholes and instituting open digital bidding
fokus.f.fok_staat_transparenz.text: Court of Accounts audits are published without censorship, eliminating preferential mega-tender exemptions.
fokus.f.fok_reg_masterplan.unter: Rectifying regional disparities across the 81 provinces
fokus.f.fok_reg_masterplan.text: The Urbanization Ministry issues a 20-year roadmap balancing mega-cities, industrial corridors and rural belts.
fokus.f.fok_reg_masterplan.zitat: A country does not grow in one place but in step across all its provinces.
fokus.f.fok_reg_kanal_istanbul.unter: Constructing an alternate global waterway between Black Sea and Marmara
fokus.f.fok_reg_kanal_istanbul.text: Excavating the 45-kilometer artificial shipping canal generating sovereign toll revenue.
fokus.f.fok_reg_marmara_schutz.unter: Halting mega-excavation to preserve marine biology and natural coastlines
fokus.f.fok_reg_marmara_schutz.text: Canceling canal excavation to safeguard regional aquifers and marine ecosystems with modern treatment plants.
fokus.f.fok_reg_erdbebenfestung.unter: Aggressive seismic retrofitting across North and East Anatolian faults
fokus.f.fok_reg_erdbebenfestung.text: Subsidized retrofitting and strict mandatory reconstruction of vulnerable building stock.
fokus.f.fok_reg_erdbebenfestung.zitat: Earthquakes do not kill people; bad buildings do.
fokus.f.fok_reg_schnellbahn.unter: Bullet-train corridors linking Thrace to Eastern Anatolia and the southern coast
fokus.f.fok_reg_schnellbahn.text: Electrified high-speed lines integrate interior provinces into a unified commercial commuter basin.
fokus.f.fok_reg_gap2.unter: Completing modern irrigation trunk canals turning the plains into an agricultural export breadbasket
fokus.f.fok_reg_gap2.text: Automated drip irrigation and hydroelectric reservoirs turn the arid southeast into a multi-crop harvest zone.
fokus.f.fok_reg_energie_drehkreuz.unter: Base-load nuclear reactors paired with vast inland solar generation
fokus.f.fok_reg_energie_drehkreuz.text: Integrating multi-gigawatt nuclear units with expansive solar farms slashes carbon emissions and gas import deficits.
fokus.f.fok_wis_auftakt.unter: High-value R&D as the primary engine of modern prosperity
fokus.f.fok_wis_auftakt.text: Doubling research budgets for universities and state institutes to foster frontier technological breakthroughs.
fokus.f.fok_wis_auftakt.zitat: The truest guide in life is science.
fokus.f.fok_wis_ki_zentrum.unter: Sovereign supercomputing cluster and native Turkish LLMs
fokus.f.fok_wis_ki_zentrum.text: Constructing sovereign high-performance computing centers to train native models for public and industrial use.
fokus.f.fok_wis_halbleiter.unter: Cleanrooms producing automotive and defense-grade microchips
fokus.f.fok_wis_halbleiter.text: Domestic manufacturing of gallium-nitride and silicon wafer chips ensures strategic supply chain immunity.
fokus.f.fok_wis_raumfahrt.unter: Indigenous spaceport and orbital lunar lander program
fokus.f.fok_wis_raumfahrt.text: Developing indigenous satellite launch vehicles and propulsion stages for lunar exploration.
fokus.f.fok_wis_satellitennetz.unter: High-resolution optical reconnaissance and encrypted communications
fokus.f.fok_wis_satellitennetz.text: Deploying synthetic aperture radar satellites providing 24/7 all-weather surveillance for crisis response.
fokus.f.fok_wis_brain_drain.unter: Repatriation fellowships and full academic autonomy for research faculty
fokus.f.fok_wis_brain_drain.text: Matching international compensation and guaranteeing research liberty attracts thousands of expatriate scientists back.
fokus.f.fok_wis_quanten_bio.unter: Frontier research in quantum cryptography and personalized genomics
fokus.f.fok_wis_quanten_bio.text: Investing in quantum key distribution and next-generation mRNA platforms to ensure epidemic resilience.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_preiswahrheit.unter: Reveal subsidies and set exit dates
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_preiswahrheit.text: The cabinet discloses all energy and price caps, calculates their budget cost and gives each a sunset date.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_preiswahrheit.zitat: A cap without a date is a mortgage without a due date.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_formalisierung.titel: Bringing the Informal Economy to Light
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_formalisierung.text: Digital till mandates, receipt lotteries and simplified small-business tax bring millions of relationships into the register — by incentive, not just audit.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_formalisierung.zitat: If everyone pays, everyone pays less; that is the only tax morale that lasts.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_mikrofinanz.unter: Microcredit for crafts, women-led firms and villages
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_mikrofinanz.text: A microfinance program through state banks reaches firms with customers but no balance sheet.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_mikrofinanz.zitat: The shortest lesson in credit: trust is the title, interest the clause.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wirkstoff.titel: Active Ingredients from Our Own Plant
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wirkstoff.text: Active-ingredient production and generics series are localized with insurer purchase guarantees.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wirkstoff.zitat: A country that does not make its own pills renegotiates every winter.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_fachkraefte_rueckholun: Return program for engineers and skilled workers
Tax holidays, research posts and foreign-degree recognition call back those who left.
Emigration is a savings plan with no payout, until the state cancels it.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wasserstoff.unter: Turning solar and wind power into an export good
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wasserstoff.text: Electrolyzers on the wind and solar coasts produce hydrogen for European buyers under long offtake contracts.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_wasserstoff.zitat: The Aegean wind was always an export; now it has a pipeline.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_kohle_schutz.text: Domestic coal plants keep running; the regions get employment guarantees together with resettlement programs.
fokus.f.fok2_wirt_kohle_schutz.zitat: Whoever closes the pit must first say who will work in the town afterwards.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_raketen.unter: Ballistic missiles as a deterrence layer
fokus.f.fok2_sich_raketen.text: Missile brigades gain range classes and series production; deterrence becomes its own doctrine layer.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_raketen.zitat: Deterrence is the only language every neighbour understands without translation.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_grenze_digital.text: Land borders gain sensor lines and a joint picture center; smuggling routes go cold.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_grenze_digital.zitat: A border that can see needs to shoot less.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_reserve.text: Reservists get short regular refresher training and assigned units; on paper the reserve long existed.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_reserve.zitat: Conscription left millions of names; the reserve must be able to call them again.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_zivilschutz.titel: Civil Defense as a National Duty
fokus.f.fok2_sich_zivilschutz.unter: Building AFAD into a rapid-response force
fokus.f.fok2_sich_zivilschutz.text: The disaster agency gains search-and-rescue battalions, depots in every region and airlift rights.
fokus.f.fok2_sich_zivilschutz.zitat: After the quake it is not the weapons that count but the diggers.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_jugendgarantie.unter: The youth guarantee as a legal claim
fokus.f.fok2_ges_jugendgarantie.text: Everyone under 25 gets a training, job or education placement within six months.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_jugendgarantie.zitat: A country that offers its young nothing leaves them to the street.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_pflege.unter: A care system for the aging population
fokus.f.fok2_ges_pflege.text: Care insurance, day centers and paid family care are merged into one system.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_pflege.zitat: Every society is measured by who cares for its old.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_pflege.urheber: Ministry of social affairs, project study
fokus.f.fok2_ges_kulturstrassen.unter: Theaters, libraries and studios into provincial centers
fokus.f.fok2_ges_kulturstrassen.text: Every provincial capital gets a culture street with stage, library and workshops; the metropolises lose their monopoly.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_kulturstrassen.zitat: Culture that lives in only three cities is a certificate, not culture.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_transparenz.unt: Financial transparency for the religious affairs directorate
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_transparenz.tex: Directorate spending is itemized per office and audited by the court of accounts.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_transparenz.zit: Whoever pays for faith may also ask what for.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_ausbau.unter: Strengthening mosques, Quran courses and chaplaincy
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_ausbau.text: The directorate budget grows; new mosques, Quran courses and hospital chaplaincy are funded.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_diyanet_ausbau.zitat: A country that builds its houses of prayer also builds its neighbourhoods.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_gedenkpolitik.unter: Openly negotiating memorial days, monuments and curricula
fokus.f.fok2_ges_gedenkpolitik.text: An independent memory council proposes days, monuments and school content; all sides present their memory.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_gedenkpolitik.zitat: A memory no one shares divides the country.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_heldenkanon.unter: A unified history canon and heroes' days
fokus.f.fok2_ges_heldenkanon.text: Curricula align on a national canon; heroes' days and symbols gain standing.
fokus.f.fok2_ges_heldenkanon.zitat: Those who do not know their heroes invent some, usually worse ones.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_afrika.unter: Densifying embassies, flight routes and trade chambers
fokus.f.fok2_aus_afrika.text: Embassy networks, airlines and trade chambers open in twenty more states; the opening becomes an institution.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_afrika.zitat: Whoever gets calls in twenty capitals can no longer be ignored.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_zollunion2.text: Agriculture, digital, visas and decision rights are negotiated in one comprehensive renegotiation.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_zollunion2.zitat: A treaty from the last century is not a framework but a shackle.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_vermittlerzentrum.text: A standing mediation center with guest protocol, expert staff and archive is founded; the grain experience becomes textbook.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_vermittlerzentrum.zitat: The mediator belongs to no one; that is his only property.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_turkstaaten_schulen.unt: Education institutes across the Turkic states
fokus.f.fok2_aus_turkstaaten_schulen.tex: Schools, scholarships and teacher programs across the Turkic states are raised to an organization-wide institution.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_turkstaaten_schulen.zit: Borders that cannot be moved are extended through classrooms.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_sicherheitsrat.unter: Non-permanent seat: a campaign at the General Assembly
fokus.f.fok2_aus_sicherheitsrat.text: A campaign for a non-permanent Security Council seat is built; every promised mediation year is a vote.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_sicherheitsrat.zitat: The Security Council does not elect power; it elects usefulness.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_kaspische_pipeline.unte: Central Asian gas through our own route
fokus.f.fok2_aus_kaspische_pipeline.text: The state takes patronage of the subsea pipeline across the Caspian; transit becomes a negotiation series.
fokus.f.fok2_aus_kaspische_pipeline.zita: Gas that does not flow through your own pipes is someone else's gas.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_egovernment.text: Applications, permits and decisions run digitally with deadline guarantees; delay becomes a compensation case.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_egovernment.zitat: A state that answers in two days no longer has to convince anyone that it exists.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_ombudsstelle.unter: Complaint as a right, data as property
fokus.f.fok2_staat_ombudsstelle.text: The ombudsman gains investigative powers; a data protection authority oversees state data stores.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_ombudsstelle.zitat: Every complaint that gets an answer is a vote that is not lost.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_hsk_gewichtung.unter: Shifting judicial council membership to the judiciary
fokus.f.fok2_staat_hsk_gewichtung.text: The judiciary elects a majority of council seats itself; the ministry keeps a minority share.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_hsk_gewichtung.zitat: Whoever chooses the judges decides every verdict not yet spoken.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_notstandshygiene.tite: Deadlines for the State of Emergency
fokus.f.fok2_staat_notstandshygiene.unte: Fixing catalog, deadlines and review in law
fokus.f.fok2_staat_notstandshygiene.text: The state of emergency gets a measures catalog, short deadlines and mandatory review; the exception becomes procedure.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_notstandshygiene.zita: The state of emergency is permanent rule's favourite coat; give it sleeves made of law.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_lokalautonomie.unter: Metropolitan districts and municipalities with own rights
fokus.f.fok2_staat_lokalautonomie.text: Districts and municipalities gain planning and budget rights under the European local government charter.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_lokalautonomie.zitat: Whether a street has water is decided in the district, not in the capital.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_gouverneure.titel: A Firm Hand in the Provinces
fokus.f.fok2_staat_gouverneure.text: Governors are centrally appointed, kept in office longer and equipped with crisis powers.
fokus.f.fok2_staat_gouverneure.zitat: In a crisis someone must obey when called, and that is a name, not a committee.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_hafentrio.unter: Expanding Trabzon, Samsun and Mersin together
fokus.f.fok2_reg_hafentrio.text: Three port builds start in parallel; the coasts compete for capacity instead of waiting in line elsewhere.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_hafentrio.zitat: A country with three seas cannot afford a single port as a bottleneck.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_korridor_mitte.text: The missing corridor between the coastal motorways is closed; Central Anatolia becomes a transit region.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_korridor_mitte.zitat: Two motorways without a link are like two phones without a network.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_gap_wasser.text: The final irrigation stages of the southeastern project are completed; farms instead of construction sites.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_gap_wasser.zitat: A dammed river is a promise; an irrigated field is its fulfilment.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_karadeniz_kueste.unter: Tourism infrastructure on the Black Sea
fokus.f.fok2_reg_karadeniz_kueste.text: Coastal roads, airport expansion and protected zones make the northern coast a second season region.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_karadeniz_kueste.zitat: The clouds belong to the coast; the guests follow the road.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_waldbrand.unter: Water points, watchtowers and firefighting aircraft
fokus.f.fok2_reg_waldbrand.text: Wildfire infrastructure is built as its own network: water points, towers, firebreaks and an air fleet.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_waldbrand.zitat: Summer comes every year; the fire ponds cannot be rebuilt every year.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_verwaltungscampus.unter: Bundling ministries and registers in one place
fokus.f.fok2_reg_verwaltungscampus.text: An administrative campus bundles ministries, registers and archives; the city gains a new center, the state shorter routes.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_verwaltungscampus.zitat: Today a city lies between two ministries; on the campus, a corridor.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_grossstadt_bezirke.text: Istanbul, Ankara and İzmir gain districts with their own planning and road budgets; the center keeps the networks.
fokus.f.fok2_reg_grossstadt_bezirke.zita: The district knows its potholes by house number; the centre knows them as statistics.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_chips_28.unter: The first fully digital chip site
fokus.f.fok2_wis_chips_28.text: A fabrication line for mature chips (28 nm) is built with a partner state and buyers from defense and autos.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_chips_28.zitat: Whoever imports chips borrows every crisis from abroad.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_offene_modelle.unter: Publishing state language models as open models
fokus.f.fok2_wis_offene_modelle.text: The administration publishes its language models openly; universities and startups build on them.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_offene_modelle.zitat: A model no one can audit is not a state model but a belief.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_impfstoffwerk.unter: Counting vaccine production as national defense
fokus.f.fok2_wis_impfstoffwerk.text: A GMP-certified vaccine and ingredient plant is built; the next epidemic does not begin with an import stop.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_impfstoffwerk.zitat: Vaccine is the only weapon whose factory must be built in peacetime.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_zellen.unter: Cell production for storage and e-mobility
fokus.f.fok2_wis_zellen.text: Cell production with domestic and imported feedstock supplies storage plants and the auto industry.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_zellen.zitat: Sun without storage is a promise made at noon.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_supercomputer.titel: A Data Center for the Nation
fokus.f.fok2_wis_supercomputer.unter: A national computing and training center
fokus.f.fok2_wis_supercomputer.text: A data center with training capacity serves universities, administration and industry; compute time becomes a grant.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_supercomputer.zitat: Computing time is the new land: whoever lacks it builds on someone else's ground.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_weltraumwetter.unter: Telescopes, satellite warning and space observation
fokus.f.fok2_wis_weltraumwetter.text: A large telescope and a space weather center protect satellite operations and the grid.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_weltraumwetter.zitat: The sun gives the markets no warning; our control centre must.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_rueckkehrstipendien.tex: Return scholarships, lab posts and dual residencies bring scholars from abroad to home chairs.
fokus.f.fok2_wis_rueckkehrstipendien.zit: The country's most expensive export is a doctorate it never sees again.
